shared_component_reference.geometry_policy: Reuse source STL unchanged, with meter-to-mm conversion and explicit CAD orientation only.
shared_component_reference.dynamics_policy: Never infer gearbox, torque, gains, backlash, or collision validity from shared visual geometry.

body_envelope_w_h_d_mm.use_limit: Envelope and clearance studies only; not a mounting interface.

stall_at_5v.use_limit: Stall data is not a continuous torque or allowable duty-cycle rating.

communication.framing: 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity

manufacturer_candidate.current_measurement_caveat: XL330 measures current at its input power source; it is not a direct phase-current or calibrated output-force measurement.

power_behavior.statement: U2D2 does not supply power to DYNAMIXEL; an external supply is required.

arms-handover-v1.derivation: Two arm bases at y = -75 mm and +75 mm in rlx/rlx/environments/arm.py.

arms-co-carry-v1.derivation: Two arm bases at y = -121 mm and +121 mm in rlx/rlx/environments/arm.py.

physical_station_requirement.alternative: Use separate scenario-specific base plates or redesign and revalidate the platform and simulation layouts.

payload.release_condition: Bench torque, thermal, tracking, grip, drop, and repeated-cycle tests must pass for the actual arm.

power_architecture.capacity_basis: Six published 5 V stall currents sum arithmetically to 8.82 A; stall is prohibited as an operating condition.
protection: DC-rated manually latched e-stop opens the positive conductor for each arm
one upstream fuse or breaker per arm sized after conductor and connector selection
one protected power branch per actuator
common signal reference between each arm supply and its U2D2 TTL bus
no connection to the original Microduck battery positive or body actuator bus

servo_mount.reason: Published nominal CAD/drawings do not define project manufacturing process, mating-part tolerances, purchased-part variation, horn stack, cable bend clearance, or fit allowance.
servo_mount.prohibited_output: No servo mounting holes, horn bolt circle, pilot fit, or tapped-hole depth is encoded in generated fabrication geometry.
unblock_evidence: Official XL330 STEP/DWG imported and revision recorded
Fastener and thread engagement selected from official instructions
Cable bend and connector insertion/removal clearance measured
Printed or machined fit coupon passes
Tolerance stack reviewed for the chosen manufacturing process

base_clamp.reason: Actual table thickness, clamp geometry, friction, overturning load, and a physical adjustment mechanism spanning the 150-242 mm simulation layouts are not measured or validated.

gripper.reason: Coupling geometry, fingertip force, contact sensing, and width mapping require prototype measurements.

certification.statement: These files are engineering concept artifacts and do not claim machinery, electrical, functional-safety, or manufacturing certification.
